name: monthly-pdo-pgi-registration-verify
description: Monthly PDO/PGI designation verification — checks all badged products against EU GI register.
prompt: Query all products with PDO, PGI, or TSG designation. For each, verify EU registration number against the TMDN GI View register. Flag any that cannot be verified. Generate monthly PDO/PGI accuracy report. COMPLIANCE-REVIEW required before removing any badges.
